text: Gate.io's founder and CEO, Lin Han, told PANews in 2025 that Gate has not introduced outside 'strategic shareholders' at this stage and that 'the current equity structure remains independent' — i.e. privately held, with no state or sovereign-fund shareholder identified in this source. (Gate's own licenses page separately lists independently-operating regional entities in Hong Kong, Gibraltar, Malta, Australia, Dubai, the Bahamas, Japan and Cyprus, but does not name a Cayman Islands parent company.)

source.name: PANews: Exclusive interview with Gate.io founder Han Lin
source.quote: Gate.io does not have such a need at this stage, and the current equity structure remains independent.
